Vladimir

the Crimson Reaper
Mid laneTop lane

Vladimir in top lane is a patient scaling pick. He farms safely with Transfusion, heals off his opponent, and becomes a teamfight monster later. The top lane role quest gives him a free Unleashed Teleport and extra experience, which fits him perfectly.

When to pick Vladimir

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not ideal. Strong duelists like Nasus and Irelia can make his lane hard.

Pick into

  • Melee champions who can't poke him, like Jax and Yasuo
  • Poke champions he can heal through, like Jayce
  • Teams that group up for his Hemoplague
  • Long games where he can scale

Avoid into

  • Strong duelists, like Nasus and Irelia
  • Teams with lots of anti-heal
  • Hard crowd control
  • Fast games

Great teammates

AmumuHis ultimate groups enemies for your Hemoplague.
Jarvan IVHis ultimate traps enemies so you can hit them all.
OriannaHer ultimate pulls enemies together for your ultimate.

Your team needs: Pick Vladimir top when your team can play for the late game.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Heals constantly with Transfusion, so he survives long lanes
  • Ranged poke against melee top laners
  • Becomes a teamfight monster late
  • The top quest's free Teleport lets him take Ghost for teamfights

Weaknesses

  • Weak early against strong duelists
  • Grievous Wounds reduces his healing
  • Needs to farm to scale; falling behind hurts a lot
  • Hard crowd control stops him

Power spikes

  • Level 6: Hemoplague lets you win all-ins against many top laners.
  • First item (Stormsurge): more burst and speed.
  • Two items (Rabadon's Deathcap): huge damage and health.
  • Three items (Shadowflame): you can kill squishy carries in teamfights.
  • Level 18 and beyond: the top quest raises your level cap to 20, which makes Vladimir even stronger.

Top tips

  • The top quest gives you a free Unleashed Teleport. Take Ghost instead.
  • Freeze the wave near your tower when you're weak.
  • Save Sanguine Pool for ganks and all-ins.
  • Last-hit with Q to heal for free.
  • Use Unleashed Teleport to join teamfights and objectives.
  • The top quest raises your level cap to 20: keep farming late.
